metaDescription: Sign in to Tafiyar Uwa, a fictional maternal care demonstration in Gombe State.

login.headline: Maternal care in Gombe
login.intro: Try the Gombe clinic demo as a mother, health worker, hospital provider or administrator.
login.staffDescription: Use the account assigned to you at your facility.
login.motherDescription: Use the Maternal ID and PIN you received from your health worker.
login.maternalIdHint: MC- followed by six letters or numbers.
login.demoGuideDescription: Ask the person running the demo for the password or PIN that goes with one of these accounts.

dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.adminIntro: View the facilities and staff taking part in the Gombe demo.
dashboard.workerIntro: Register a mother or open her record to enter a clinic visit.
dashboard.providerIntro: Check which hospital your account belongs to.
dashboard.motherIntro: Keep your Maternal ID for your next visit.
dashboard.sharedDevice: Sign out when you finish using a shared device.

security.origin: This request could not be verified. Return to the app and try again.
security.tooLarge: This request is too large. Check your details and try again.
security.invalidForm: Enter your sign-in details and try again.
security.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
security.invalidCredentials: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details or try again in a few minutes.
security.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this page.
security.serverError: We couldn’t complete your request. Please try again.

care.name: Mother’s name
care.registrationIntro: Use fictional details only. Give the mother her Maternal ID after registration.
care.consent: The mother agrees that other participating clinics may view her record.
care.consentHint: She can register and receive care here if she leaves this unchecked.
care.openHint: Enter the Maternal ID to record a visit at your health centre. Opening the record is logged.
care.registered: Mother registered. Give her the Maternal ID shown here. She can sign in with it and her PIN.
care.previousHint: These dates were set at earlier visits.
care.noAppointment: No next appointment has been set.
care.noAppointmentHint: Ask your health worker for the date of your next visit.

careErrors.notFound: No record with that ID is available at your health centre.
careErrors.duplicateRequest: This form has already been submitted with different details. Open a fresh form to start again.
careErrors.idUnavailable: A Maternal ID could not be created. Please try again.
careErrors.invalidName: Enter a name within the allowed length.
careErrors.invalidAge: Enter an age in whole years, from 0 to 120.
careErrors.invalidPin: Choose a PIN of 8 to 12 digits.
careErrors.pinMismatch: The two PINs must match. Enter them again.
careErrors.invalidRequest: Reopen the form and try again.
careErrors.invalidNumber: Check the measurement and its format.
careErrors.invalidPressure: Enter two numbers separated by a slash, such as 120/80.
careErrors.futureVisit: The visit date cannot be later than today.
careErrors.appointmentBeforeVisit: Choose an appointment date on or after the visit date.
